Claim tested: CACUL1 is a cullin-family protein that activates CDK2 at G1/S
Key finding: CAC1 (369 aa) binds CDK2, raises CDK2 activity; knockdown causes G1/S arrest. Described as containing a cullin domain.
Context: Human cell lines, co-IP and cell cycle assays
Confidence and limitations: Primary and reproducible for the CDK2 link; the cullin designation is a sequence inference in the same paper, not an assay. Source of 4 of the 10 current GO annotations.

Claim tested: CACUL1 associates with the Cul3-Keap1 complex and modulates Nrf2 ubiquitination
Key finding: CACUL1 associates with Cul3-Keap1; decreases Nrf2 ubiquitination basally and under oxidative stress; knockdown lowers Nrf2 activity and cell viability; induced in cells and mice by Nrf2-activating stress.
Context: Human cells and mouse tissue, co-IP and ubiquitination assays
Confidence and limitations: Only primary report of a CUL3 association. Direction of effect is reduced Nrf2 ubiquitination, that is inhibition of the ligase. Not reproduced by the CUL3 bait in BioPlex 293T.

Claim tested: CACUL1 molecular activity is nuclear receptor corepression
Key finding: CACUL1 binds SIRT1, binds PPARgamma via a CoRNR box, represses PPARgamma transcription and adipogenesis; depletion shifts SIRT1 off and LSD1 onto the PPARgamma promoter; confirmed in human adipose-derived stem cells.
Context: 3T3-L1 mouse preadipocytes and human adipose-derived stem cells
Confidence and limitations: Mechanism supported by promoter occupancy and RNA-seq. The CoRNR box residues are not resolvable from the abstract and the candidate motifs are buried in the AlphaFold model.

Claim tested: CACUL1 represses a second nuclear receptor
Key finding: CACUL1 directly associates with AR and suppresses AR transcriptional activity; competes with LSD1 for AR binding; depletion raises LSD1 occupancy of AR targets.
Context: LNCaP and LNCaP-LN3 prostate cancer cells
Confidence and limitations: Independent receptor, same mechanism class as PMID:29233982. Part of the analysis is overexpression based.

Claim tested: CACUL1 regulates SUMOylation rather than ubiquitination
Key finding: CACUL1 interacts with PML, suppresses PML SUMOylation, changes PML-NB size; Ubc9 binds CACUL1 and antagonizes the CACUL1-PML interaction; CACUL1 attenuates p53 transcriptional activity.
Context: Human cells, SUMOylation and reporter assays
Confidence and limitations: Places CACUL1 on the SUMO pathway, orthogonal to the cullin hypothesis. Calls CACUL1 a cullin-related protein, a naming carry-over.

Claim tested: CACUL1 recorded binary interactome
Key finding: ESR1 (P03372) is the only binary interactor of Q86Y37 in IntAct, over 5 experiments. Basis of one GO:0005515 IPI annotation.
Confidence and limitations: Single partner; consistent with the nuclear receptor theme but recorded as a low-information GO:0005515.

Claim tested: Second GO:0005515 IPI, with ARMC1 (Q96C12)
Key finding: Supports GO:0005515 only; no mechanism attached.
Confidence and limitations: Low information content. Should be replaced if a more informative term is supported.

Claim tested: CACUL1 supports proliferation and drug resistance
Key finding: CAC1 knockdown in 5-FU-resistant colorectal cancer: G1/S arrest, apoptosis, reduced invasion and migration, lower P-gp and MRP-1.
Confidence and limitations: Downstream phenotype, not direct activity. Consistent with the CDK2 axis.

Claim tested: Same proliferation axis in a second tumour type
Key finding: CACUL1 knockdown in glioma impedes proliferation, induces apoptosis and G1/S arrest, lowers CDK2, cyclin E1, cyclin A2.
Confidence and limitations: Downstream phenotype. Reinforces GO:0000082 and GO:0008284.

Claim tested: CACUL1 as a cullin-family E3 ligase
Key finding: CRISPR knockout in HCC inhibits proliferation and migration; PI3K/AKT enrichment; M2 macrophage polarization via Notch1. Abstract opens: Although cullin-family E3 ubiquitin ligases regulate diverse oncogenic pathways.
Confidence and limitations: Phenotype data usable; the cullin-E3 framing is name driven and not tested in the paper. Example of the carry-over this report flags.

Claim tested: CACUL1 domain content versus cullins
Key finding: CACUL1 has exactly one domain hit: PF00888/IPR001373 at 137-293 (plus IPR016159 131-334, IPR042652 1-368). CUL1 and CUL3 additionally carry PF26557, PF10557/SM00884 and IPR016158/PS50069 (CHD). None are in CACUL1. PANTHER assigns CACUL1 to PTHR46636, not cullin family PTHR11932.
Confidence and limitations: Database level but reproducible and consistent with the structural results.

Claim tested: Cullin homology in CACUL1 is confined to one N-terminal repeat
Key finding: CACUL1 vs CUL3 score 123, CACUL1 131-237 against CUL3 27-132, 24.8% identity over 109 columns; shuffle null n=60 mean 37.0 SD 4.8 max 48, z=17.9, empirical p<0.017. Against CUL3 CHD 377-768 only: score 31 vs null mean 34.5, p=0.73.
Confidence and limitations: Local alignment with an explicit null. Does not test three-dimensional similarity by itself.

Claim tested: Which part of CUL3 the CACUL1 fold matches
Key finding: 105 seed CA pairs, 100 within 5 A after iterative trimming, RMSD 1.53 A, covering CUL3 27-132 = 29% of the 4HXI CUL3 N-terminal domain and 13% of full-length CUL3. TM-score 0.282 normalized by CUL3 NTD, 0.265 by CACUL1.
Context: AF-Q86Y37 v6 against PDB 4HXI chain B
Confidence and limitations: phenix.superpose_pdbs failed at 19% identity (fitted 3 atoms), so superposition was seeded by the sequence alignment. TM-score below 0.5 means shared fold family, not shared architecture.

Claim tested: CACUL1 lacks the RBX1-binding surface
Key finding: 62 CUL1 residues within 4.5 A of RBX1 in 1LDJ, spanning CUL1 475-761. 0 of 62 have any CACUL1 counterpart.
Confidence and limitations: Unambiguous: the region does not exist in CACUL1.

Claim tested: Whether CACUL1 lacks the BTB-adaptor-binding surface of CUL3
Key finding: All 18 KEAP1-contacting CUL3 residues in 5NLB (patches 49-68 and 118-129) fall inside the CACUL1-aligned block; identity there 5/18 = 27.8% versus 22/87 = 25.3% elsewhere, Fisher OR 1.14 p 0.776. On 4HXI (KLHL11): 5/22 = 22.7%, OR 0.82 p 0.79.
Confidence and limitations: The surface is present but its chemistry sits at background conservation. Non-significant, so it neither confirms nor excludes competitor binding.

Claim tested: CACUL1 lacks the NEDD8 acceptor lysine
Key finding: CUL1 710-730 LIQAAIVRIMKMRKVLKHQQL (K720) and CUL3 702-722 EIEAAIVRIMKSRKKMQHNVL (K712) have no alignment to CACUL1; the maximum CUL3 position reached in any alignment is 132. The CACUL1 C-terminal 20 residues are AGDELAYNSSSACASSRGYR.
Confidence and limitations: Direct and unambiguous.

Claim tested: CACUL1 is a single-repeat protein across vertebrates
Key finding: 500 UniProt vertebrate CACUL1 entries, length median 317.5 aa, range 142-421, 0 entries >= 600 aa. 20 orthologs across mammals, birds, a turtle and a salmonid: SW vs CUL3 scores 121-126, alignment ends at CUL3 132 in 19 of 20 and 151 in Oncorhynchus kisutch; 0 of 20 reach past CUL3 200.
Confidence and limitations: Rules out a human annotation artifact. UniProt automatic entries dominate the set.

Claim tested: Unbiased structure search finds only the repeat
Key finding: AF-Q86Y37 against PDB100: 69 hits; top hits 4HXI_B (E=2e-6, 18.9% id), 5NLB_B CUL3 NTD with KEAP1 BTB/3-box (E=4e-6, 18.4%), 4AP2_B, 4A64_B (CUL4B NTD), 4EOZ_B (SPOP-CUL3). Query range 118-344. Across 23 significant hits to near full-length cullin chains the furthest target residue reached is 247.
Confidence and limitations: Structure based and independent of the sequence alignment; reaches the same boundary.

Claim tested: Which part of CACUL1 is ordered
Key finding: Whole protein mean pLDDT 72.6. Residues 1-130 mean 42.4 with 90% below 50. Residues 137-293 mean 95.4, all above 70. Residues 294-369 mean 75.5.
Confidence and limitations: The 130-residue N-terminus is a disordered extension with no cullin counterpart.

Claim tested: Is CACUL1 a stable CUL3 partner in cells
Key finding: BioPlex 293T (118,162 interactions, 13,957 proteins): the CUL3 bait recovered 31 preys covering the BTB adaptor repertoire plus NEDD8, ARIH1, COPS4, COPS7A, GPS1, DCUN1D1, NUDCD3. CACUL1 is absent, and absent from the whole 293T and HCT116 networks.
Confidence and limitations: Qualified negative: CACUL1 was never a bait, and a transient or stress-induced association (PMID:26238671) would not be captured.

Claim tested: Provenance of the cullin-flavoured GO terms
Key finding: Of 10 GO annotations on Q86Y37, exactly 2 are cullin derived: GO:0031625 and GO:0006511, both IEA from InterPro GO_REF:0000002 with withFrom = IPR001373. InterPro2GO maps IPR001373 to exactly these two terms; IPR016159, IPR042652 and PF00888 carry no GO mapping.
Confidence and limitations: Database level but decisive about where the terms come from.

Claim tested: Can the CoRNR box be located in the structure
Key finding: No match to the strict CoRNR consensus. Relaxed matches at 140-148 LDGAIDQLL and 183-191 LIKKITNHL, LXXLL at 264-268; all inside the folded repeat. CB neighbours within 10 A: motif means 18.2, 16.9, 16.6 against a folded-core median of 16, hydrophobic positions 19-23 and polar positions 10-15.
Confidence and limitations: Motifs are amphipathic helices buried in the core. This does not contradict PMID:29233982, because the residues that paper defined were not recoverable here.
